reconciliation.policy: Legacy baseline IDs are preserved in legacyBaselineRefs. Duplicate conceptual connections are mapped into a single canonical edge unless operationally different trust boundaries (for example API vs SSE or job request vs callback) require separate rows.
reconciliation.localFirstOverride: CI/CD -> hosted deployment is recorded as future/out-of-scope until separately approved; no hosted service is activated by this register.

policy: Every connection requires an authoritative owner, authentication boundary, data contract, failure/retry behavior, source evidence and final test evidence before runtime acceptance.
A source file or documented route does not mean the connection has been tested.
No client connects directly to the business PostgreSQL database.
No request/query secrets, OTPs, tokens, provider credentials or private keys are copied into the connection register.
Unknown provider endpoints or website destinations remain pending; do not invent a working URL.
Physical app/device/database/provider/E2E checks are deferred until all four package A-Z implementations finish.

connections.transport: HTTP API; HTTPS required for remote deployments
connections.purpose: Authentication, profile, saved locations, quote, booking, trip and customer data
connections.owner: Backend owns authoritative business data; Customer Mobile owns UI/draft state only
connections.authIdentity: Customer session; pre-auth endpoints must resolve account without leaking account existence
connections.dataContract: Versioned request/response schema; requestId; idempotency for booking/payment writes
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Typed error envelope and timeout policy required; never blindly retry non-idempotent writes

connections.transport: HTTP API; configured realtime for current-trip/offer updates
connections.purpose: Onboarding, KYC, vehicle eligibility, availability, offers, GPS, trip lifecycle and earnings
connections.owner: Backend owns driver status, geographic assignment, eligibility and trip state
connections.authIdentity: Driver session, actor binding, active account state and server-side stateId/cityId scope
connections.dataContract: Versioned request/response, current state/version, requestId, idempotency where writes can retry
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Unknown outcome must refetch authoritative state; accept/complete retry safety and GPS freshness require tests

connections.transport: HTTP API
connections.purpose: Admin data, reviews, configuration, reports, alerts and privileged actions
connections.owner: Backend enforces permissions and geographic scope; Web Admin renders authorized views
connections.authIdentity: Admin session, selected Admin Type must match server actor/role, permission and assigned geography
connections.dataContract: Canonical response/error contract, requestId, field-level validation errors, audit context
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: No retry for privileged mutations without idempotency; stale session/scope must be rejected

connections.transport: HTTP API
connections.purpose: Mobile Admin review queues, records, alerts and authorized administrative actions
connections.owner: Backend owns permissions, records and audit outcome
connections.authIdentity: Admin session; same server authorization policy as Web Admin; no UI-only permission security
connections.dataContract: Same canonical API/error contracts as Admin Web; stable requestId
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Privilege changes require safe retry/idempotency; session expiry must recover safely

connections.to: Restricted Backend control API / platform control plane
connections.transport: Private authenticated API; future transport to be approved
connections.purpose: High-impact configuration, release/environment control, security and recovery actions
connections.owner: Backend/control plane validates privileged command; dedicated app remains unimplemented beyond a shell
connections.authIdentity: Approved device-trust/private-key design; private key must never be embedded in app bundle
connections.dataContract: Signed/challenge-bound command, nonce/replay protection, requestId, explicit approval/audit
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: High-impact commands require outcome reconciliation; duplicate commands must not apply twice

connections.transport: Prisma database connection; TLS/config requirements depend on local host boundary
connections.purpose: Authoritative application records, transactions, constraints, migrations and recovery
connections.owner: Backend is sole business-database writer boundary; clients have no direct DB access
connections.authIdentity: Local DB user with least privilege; TEST DB marker and DATABASE_URL_TEST/ LIVE isolation
connections.dataContract: Approved Prisma schema, one canonical migration chain, transaction/constraint rules
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Readiness fails closed on marker mismatch; transaction retry only for safe/idempotent operations

connections.transport: HTTPS provider API; optional local OSRM adapter
connections.purpose: Route, distance, duration and ETA for booking/driver flows
connections.owner: Backend owns selected route calculation and pricing input interpretation
connections.authIdentity: Server-side provider key only; restricted quotas/domains; local adapter has no secret
connections.dataContract: Normalized origin/destination, route geometry/metrics, provider metadata and error class
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Explicit timeout/quotas, bounded retry/fallback, no infinite fallback or unbounded cost

connections.transport: HTTPS API plus signed provider callbacks
connections.purpose: Payment creation, verification, refund and reconciliation
connections.owner: Backend ledger and verified provider state are authoritative
connections.authIdentity: Server credentials; signature verification; amount/currency/order match; webhook dedupe
connections.dataContract: Provider order/payment/refund identifiers and normalized transaction state
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Idempotency and durable webhook receipt guards are present in source; live duplicate/concurrency/provider reconciliation tests remain pending.

connections.transport: HTTPS provider API/callback, as supported by current integration
connections.purpose: Driver settlement/payout initiation and status tracking
connections.owner: Backend settlement ledger is authoritative; provider status is reconciled evidence
connections.authIdentity: Server credentials, signature/authenticity checks and idempotent payout references
connections.dataContract: Settlement ID, payout attempt/provider ID, amount/currency and normalized status
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Unknown outcomes require reconciliation; provider amount/status mapping is present. Live retry, duplicate payout and bank settlement evidence remains pending.

connections.transport: Provider adapter/API/SDK selected by server configuration
connections.purpose: Purpose-bound login, protected-action OTP and configured notifications
connections.owner: Backend creates/verifies OTP challenge and resolves approved purpose-code configuration
connections.authIdentity: Server-side provider credentials; exact purposeCode validation; no client-controlled delivery override
connections.dataContract: Challenge/purpose IDs, masked target, delivery result/status, expiry and audit correlation
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Per-purpose rules; no silent push-to-SMS fallback; retries must not create unintended new OTPs

connections.transport: Server SDK / HTTPS provider API
connections.purpose: Push notification delivery, device token invalidation and notification receipt feedback where supported
connections.owner: Backend owns notification content/audience and device-token registration state
connections.authIdentity: Server-side Firebase credentials; token belongs to registered device/account and must be revocable
connections.dataContract: Minimal notification payload, event ID, locale/template key and provider result
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Bounded retries; expired/invalid token cleanup; no OTP secret in unsafe push payload by default

connections.transport: Authenticated delivery API / durable job contract
connections.purpose: Create SMS/call delivery jobs and query/receive final delivery outcome
connections.owner: Backend owns business intent/OTP challenge; Provider owns delivery-job execution only
connections.authIdentity: Service identity, signed requests/callback policy, environment and idempotency keys
connections.dataContract: Job/request ID, purpose, channel, masked/controlled destination, expiry and status
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Job survives restart, bounded retries, request dedupe and authoritative result reconciliation

connections.transport: Authenticated callback/API with signature/timestamp and deduplication
connections.purpose: Reconcile Provider delivery outcomes back to the Backend business request
connections.owner: Provider reports observed delivery result; Backend decides OTP/notification state transition
connections.authIdentity: Service authentication, signature verification, replay/timestamp controls and request correlation
connections.dataContract: requestId/resultId, delivery status, attempt metadata and sanitized failure reason
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Out-of-order/duplicate callback safe; bounded retry outbox; no status inference from HTTP 200 alone

connections.transport: Authenticated poll/claim/lease/ACK protocol; signed config/commands
connections.purpose: Deliver queued SMS/call task to assigned Gateway/device and reconcile attempts/results
connections.owner: Provider owns delivery queue; Gateway owns local attempt execution; Backend owns business consequence
connections.authIdentity: gatewayId + deviceId + installationId + assignedMobileNumber/deviceName mapping; per-device credentials and revocation
connections.dataContract: job/command ID, attempt/lease expiry, bounded command/result schema, monotonic sequence where required
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Duplicate claim/ACK, lease expiry, device crash, revocation and late result must be idempotent

auditEvidence.knownBoundary: Provider storage driver choice, production base URL/trust-key provisioning, device/SIM behavior and restart/lease-expiry integration remain release blockers

connections.transport: Android platform telephony APIs and carrier network
connections.purpose: Perform permitted SMS/call attempt with accurate device/SIM failure result
connections.owner: Gateway reports observed platform attempt; Provider/Backend determine higher-level state
connections.authIdentity: Trusted registered Gateway app/device, explicit runtime permission, destination/purpose policy
connections.dataContract: Attempt ID, channel, result status, platform failure class and timestamps; no false delivered status
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Permission denied, no SIM/service, dual-SIM ambiguity and offline behavior need device tests

auditEvidence.knownBoundary: Manifest permissions do not prove runtime permission grant, SIM availability, carrier delivery, call completion or callback accuracy

connections.transport: HTTPS navigation link; no auth proxy
connections.purpose: Open correct Web Admin login destination from public pages
connections.owner: Website owns public content/link only; Admin Web owns authentication
connections.authIdentity: No privilege gained from coming from public site; Web Admin performs its own login
connections.dataContract: Verified destination origin/path and download link destinations
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Domain/TLS/destination checks deferred; placeholder links must not be advertised as working

connections.transport: Authenticated API as appropriate for actor, with constrained pre-auth cases if explicitly needed
connections.purpose: Register/refresh/unregister push tokens and bind token to current actor/device
connections.owner: Backend persists registration and authoritative association; provider token validity remains external
connections.authIdentity: Actor/session/device ownership check and token rotation/revocation
connections.dataContract: Platform, token, app version, device identity, actor identity and requestId
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Duplicate registration idempotent; invalid/reassigned token cleaned up; no token values in logs

connections.transport: Server-side storage API and/or expiring signed upload/download URLs
connections.purpose: KYC documents, private attachments, app assets and protected media
connections.owner: Backend decides access; object store only stores bytes/metadata
connections.authIdentity: Server/service identity; per-object authorization; expiring signature for client upload/download
connections.dataContract: Object ID, owner, MIME type, size, checksum, status and expiry
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Private by default, MIME/size limits, expired URL rejection, cross-user access denied

connections.transport: Deployment API/configuration
connections.purpose: Build/deploy/release/rollback to hosted target
connections.owner: Release approval process owns deploy intent; source repo holds no deploy secrets
connections.authIdentity: Protected CI credential and explicit release approval
connections.dataContract: Artifact digest, version, environment, health result and rollback reference
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Not active for the current local-only foundation; requires future explicit approval before use

connections.transport: Process stdout/stderr and in-process metrics; hosted monitoring is not active by default
connections.purpose: Request correlation, latency/error counters, security and operational diagnosis
connections.owner: Each service owns safe logs; security/ops owner defines access and retention
connections.authIdentity: Local OS/process access; admin observability endpoint permission-gated
connections.dataContract: requestId, route template, method, status, bounded metric values, sanitized reason codes
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: No query-string/raw-secret logging; bounded alerts; persistent dashboards/remote export await approval

connections.transport: Authenticated Server-Sent Events stream
connections.purpose: Booking, offer, trip and other authorized actor-scoped state-change notifications
connections.owner: Backend authorizes and publishes; client cursor is not authoritative business state
connections.authIdentity: Session actor binding and server-side subscription/audience check
connections.dataContract: Event ID/type/version, actor audience, request/booking correlation and minimized payload
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Last-Event-ID, replay gap and reconnect need authorization, duplicate and stale-cursor tests

connections.transport: Authenticated Server-Sent Events stream
connections.purpose: Update Admin workspaces and operational queues without stale UI state
connections.owner: Backend enforces admin permission/scope; UI refreshes authoritative API on gaps
connections.authIdentity: Admin actor identity and server-side geographic/data scope on subscription and replay
connections.dataContract: event ID/type, actor scope, replay cursor and schema version
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Permission revocation, reconnect, replay gap, duplicate and stale snapshot recovery need tests

connections.transport: Provider storage abstraction; JSON, SQLite and PostgreSQL paths are all present in current source
connections.purpose: Persist device/session/config/queues/delivery results/retry outbox/security audit
connections.owner: Provider owns delivery execution records; exact authoritative store is not yet selected
connections.authIdentity: Local TEST isolation and DB credential separation where applicable; storage-specific access control
connections.dataContract: One canonical persistence adapter/schema per environment; migrations and durable commit semantics
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Do not run mixed active writers/stores; choose authority and test crash/restart/idempotency in final phase

connections.transport: Provider API/SDK if configured
connections.purpose: Create/reconcile masked-call sessions without exposing personal telephone numbers
connections.owner: Backend validates authorization, purpose and call lifecycle; provider reports telecom state
connections.authIdentity: Server credential, permitted number/region policy and per-request audit
connections.dataContract: Call session ID, masked numbers, requestId, expiry and normalized status
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Timeout/unknown result and number privacy tests; provider enablement must be explicit in local TEST

connections.transport: Static link or asset URL
connections.purpose: Expose the correct approved Android/iOS download and public support/policy destinations
connections.owner: Website owns link presentation; signed/versioned release artifact is authoritative elsewhere
connections.authIdentity: Public read only; no Admin auth or tokens forwarded
connections.dataContract: Verified destination URL, release version/platform and fallback/support URL
connections.failureTimeoutRetry: Download/admin destinations remain disabled until approved; no destination is inferred or claimed working. Browser/device link checks remain pending.
